idea-plugin.name: Dual Terminal Windows
idea-plugin.description:
Adds independently movable terminal tool windows to JetBrains IDEs for developers who want simultaneous shells in different places.

Choose between one and four Extra Terminal windows. Each can be docked, resized, floated, and moved separately. Every shell starts in the project root and uses the IDE's configured terminal shell.

This beta targets JetBrains IDE builds 253 through 262 and uses the bundled Classic terminal implementation.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• Adds a configurable number of independently movable terminal tool windows.
  • Starts each shell in the current project root.
  • Remembers tool-window placement through the IDE layout system.
